source.description:
## SCOPE
Phase A of xtrm-lwpcn: ship the detect+report-only reusable workflow.

### Deliverables
1. .github/workflows/service-skills-drift-sweep.yml — reusable workflow (on: workflow_call), no model/API key needed.
2. Inputs: scripts-path (default .xtrm/skills/default/service-skills/scripts), default-branch (default main).
3. Logic: checkout, setup python, import scan_drift, dump JSON, on drift>0 post comment on merged PR.

### Out of scope (deferred to Phase B)
- sp script auto-reconcile on runner (needs bun + specialists install + API key).
- Auto-PR for last_sync_ref bumps.

### Validation
- [ ] Workflow file ships in xtrm-tools main
- [ ] Caller workflow in mercury-infra references it via uses: xtrm-dev/core/.github/workflows/service-skills-drift-sweep.yml@main
- [ ] Forced-drift scenario on mercury-infra produces a PR comment with drift summary
